title: The Scorecard for Synthetic Medical Data Evaluation and Reporting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the stability and uniformity of synthetic data quality metrics (such as coverage and constraints) across diverse patient demographic subgroups using statistical measurements like Variance, Maximum-Minimum Difference, and Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) to prevent downstream disparities.
Assessing the consistency of synthetic medical data quality across different disease classes or condition-specific subgroups to ensure uniform performance and prevent representation disparities.
